Question 11(b) [4 marks]: How do the inputs of a business that produces goods differ from the inputs of a business that provides services?

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Relates cause and effect of differences between inputs of a business that provides a good as opposed to a service
3 marks: Provides characteristics and features of differences between inputs of a business that provides a good as opposed to a service
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the differences between inputs of a business that provides a good as opposed to a service
1 marks: Recognises and names the differences between inputs of a goods based business as opposed to a service based business


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Goods are tangible, services are intangible. Talk about transformed and transforming resources: goods need raw materials, machinery and facilities; services rely more on the skills and knowledge of people and on the customer as an input.

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Needed to relate cause and effect. Some students only described or outlined.
